publications.title: Reserve Bank holds 36 th Conference of State Finance Secretaries
publications.summary: The 36 th Conference of State Finance Secretaries was held on October 27, 2026 at RBI, Mumbai. The theme of the Conference was ‘Role of Quality of Expenditure, Effective Cash and Prudent Debt Management in Enhancing States' Fiscal Sustainability'. The Conference was attended by the Finance Secretaries of 27 States and three Union Territories as well as senior officials from the Ministry of Finance, Government of India, Controller General of Accounts and the Comptroller and Auditor General of India. Governor, Reserve Bank of India inaugurated the Conference. Addressing the participants, the Governor emphasised the importance of maintaining the quality of expenditure to ensure the long-term fiscal health of the States. publications.title: Bullseye Financial Ltd enters administration
publications.summary: On 23 October 2026, Bullseye Financial Ltd (Bullseye Financial) entered administration. Robert Young of Azets Holdings Limited and Matthew Haw of RSM UK Restructuring Advisory LLP were appointed as joint administrators. The joint administrators are responsible for managing the affairs of the firm during the administration process.Bullseye Financial is authorised by the FCA. It served only professional investors, either managing investment portfolios for them within agreed limits or carrying out their instructions to buy or sell investments without giving investment advice.On 11 March 2026, Bullseye Financial agreed to a voluntary requirement to stop carrying out any regulated activity.Below we set out:How to contact the joint administrators.Support for customers.What to do if you are concerned about your investments.What to do if you have a complaint with the firm.How to protect yourself
